dock.dismiss: Hide this bubble until the next message
dock.dismissAll: Hide all bubbles until the next message
tray.hideFromCapture: Hide from screen sharing and screenshots
outside.mute: Keep the bubble, no sound or preview
confirm.signoutDetail: This clears the saved login and cookies for this account only. You will need to sign in again.
confirm.removeDetail: The bubble and the saved login for this account are deleted. Your messages stay on the service.
picker.title: Add account — Chatlings
picker.heading: Add an account
picker.sub: Pick an app. You sign in on its official web page, inside Chatlings. Add the same app several times for several accounts.
picker.tier2Hint: Unread counts come from the tab title or badges only, so they can be less precise.
picker.funHint: Free 3D games by the author, play online with friends. Opens in your browser.
picker.customHint: Any other web chat: give it a name and its https:// address. Unread counts are read from the page title.
picker.badUrl: Please enter a full https:// address.
picker.loginPassword: Sign in on the web page
picker.unsupportedList: LINE, Viber, Signal, KakaoTalk. WeChat Web blocks most new accounts.
picker.privacyNote: Chatlings is not affiliated with any of these services. Your login stays on this computer; Chatlings sends no data anywhere.
perm.detail: Requested by {host}. Only allowed while this chat is open in front of you.
settings.acc.mediaHint: For calls. Never allowed in the background, only while this chat is open.
donate.title: Buy the author a coffee
donate.lead: Chatlings is free and has no ads. If it saves you time, a coffee keeps it going. Thank you!
donate.scan: Scan with any Vietnamese banking app (VietQR)
lock.title: Chatlings is locked
lock.sub: Enter your PIN to open your chats.
lock.invalid: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.
update.ready: Chatlings {version} is ready. Restart now to update?
settings.title: Settings — Chatlings
settings.mergeHint: One bubble with the total; click it to fan out every account.
settings.previewsHint: Shows the last 3 messages next to the bubble. Kept in memory only, never written to disk.
settings.autoPeekHint: When a message arrives, its preview appears next to the bubble for 6 seconds. It does not take the keyboard away from what you are typing.
settings.checkUpdatesHint: Asks GitHub Releases once a day. Nothing else is sent.
settings.gpuHint: Off saves about 60 MB of RAM. Turn on if video calls or animations stutter. Takes effect after restarting Chatlings.
settings.groupHint: Turn a whole profile on or off.
settings.acc.name: Name
settings.acc.hiddenHint: The account keeps running; you can open it from the tray.
settings.acc.muteNativeHint: While the popup is hidden. Sound comes back when you open it, so calls still work.
settings.acc.sleepHint: A sleeping account uses almost no RAM. It wakes up briefly to check for new messages.
settings.acc.idleMinutes: Fall asleep after not using it for (minutes)
settings.captureHint: Chatlings windows are left out of screenshots, recordings and screen sharing (Meet, Zoom, Teams, OBS). You still see them. Turn off to take a screenshot of your bubbles.
settings.notOnThisOs: Not available on Linux: the system does not let apps hide from screen capture.
settings.presentHint: Hides bubbles when Windows reports presentation mode or a full-screen game. A maximised Excel does not count.
settings.pin.title: PIN lock
settings.pin.warning: The PIN only stops other people using this PC from opening your chats. It does not encrypt your login data.
settings.pin.removeHint: Enter the current PIN above first.
settings.pin.auto: Lock after the PC is idle for (minutes)
settings.mem.truth: Most of the RAM is used by the chat websites themselves: every awake account is its own browser process, because separate logins need separate processes. Put accounts to sleep to free it.
settings.mem.thresholdHint: Web chats leak memory over days. Checked every 5 minutes, only while the popup is hidden. 0 = never.
about.tagline: Floating chat heads for your web chats. Multi-account, open source.
about.privacyText: No telemetry, no analytics, no servers of our own. Chatlings only talks to the chat sites you add and to GitHub Releases for updates.
about.nlvText: Anonymous, honest company reviews in Vietnam
about.disclaimer: Chatlings is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Zalo, Meta, Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack, Microsoft, Google, X, LinkedIn, Element or any other supported service. All trademarks belong to their owners.
